message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has checked the times I sent, and none of them work for Elena and David. He has sent me a new list of times to check against Priya's and Marcus's calendars. I need to go through this new list and see if any of these times work for Priya and Marcus.

Here's Brad's list of times:
- Mon Nov 16: 11:00 AM, 11:30 AM
- Tue Nov 17: 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM
- Wed Nov 18: 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM
- Thu Nov 19: 9:30 AM, 3:00 PM
- Fri Nov 20: 3:00 PM, 3:30 PM

I will now check these times against the calendars I have for Priya and Marcus.

Priya's busy times:
- Mon Nov 16: 11:00-11:30 is busy (Travel). 11:30-12:00 is busy.
- Tue Nov 17: 9:00-9:30 is busy (Board prep). 9:30-10:00 is busy (Partner lunch).
- Wed Nov 18: 1:00-1:30 is busy (Client call - Harbor Logistics). 1:30-2:00 is busy (Client dinner prep).
- Thu Nov 19: 9:30-10:00 is busy.
- Fri Nov 20: 3:00-3:30 is busy. 3:30-4:00 is busy.

Marcus's busy times:
- Mon Nov 16: 11:00-11:30 is free. 11:30-12:00 is busy.
- Tue Nov 17: 9:00-9:30 is busy (Recruiting call). 9:30-10:00 is busy (Litigation strategy).
- Wed Nov 18: 1:00-1:30 is busy (Partner lunch). 1:30-2:00 is busy (Litigation strategy).
- Thu Nov 19: 9:30-10:00 is busy (Contract review - Weller Group). 3:00-3:30 is busy (Board prep).
- Fri Nov 20: 3:00-3:30 is busy (Travel). 3:30-4:00 is busy.

It seems none of the times Brad proposed work for Priya and Marcus. I need to find a new set of common available times for Priya and Marcus and send them to Brad.

Let's re-examine the calendars for Priya and Marcus to find all common 30-minute slots.

Priya's free slots:
Mon: 9:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00
Tue: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00
Thu: 9:00-9:30, 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00
Fri: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30

Marcus's free slots:
Mon: 9:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30, 15:00-15:30
Tue: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 9:00-9:30, 12:00-12:30, 15:00-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30
Fri: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00

Common free slots for Priya and Marcus:
Mon: 9:00-10:00
Tue: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
Wed: 15:00-16:00
Thu: 10:00-10:30
Fri: 11:00-12:00

Now I will send these new proposed times to Brad.<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad and I have exchanged a round of emails and have not yet found a time that works for all four partners. I've re-analyzed Priya's and Marcus's calendars and have a new list of times to propose. I will send this new list to Brad and ask him to check it against Elena's and David's calendars. This is the next logical step in our collaborative process.
